user.title: Add a Hearth device
user.description: Enter the device's host and port. The app serves one integration session at a time (newest wins): migrate from VACA per device by deleting its VACA entry first.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add a Hearth device
zeroconf_confirm.description: Add {name} to Home Assistant? The app serves one integration session at a time (newest wins); if this device still has a VACA entry, delete it first.

toast.name: Show toast
toast.description: Shows a short on-screen message on the Hearth device.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Posts a notification to the Hearth device's notification area.

severity.name: Severity
severity.description: Visual severity of the notification row.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds until the notification auto-dismisses. Omit or 0 for persistent.

id.name: ID
id.description: Stable id; re-posting the same id replaces that row.

notify_clear.name: Clear notification
notify_clear.description: Clears one notification by id, or all notifications. Provide exactly one of id or all.

all.name: All
all.description: Clear all notifications on the device.
